title: Tempo Provider Score
description: Declarative definition of a Tempo source: identifier, display, color, severity mapping, and default actions.

_bundledVersion.description: Version stamp used by Tempo's bundled-score seeder to detect updates. Optional; only used in bundled JSON shipped inside the app.

providerIdentifier.description: Stable, namespaced identifier for the source (reverse-DNS or scripts.<lang>.<name>).

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the source panel.

color.description: Accent color for this source, as #RRGGBB.

helper.description: Optional descriptor for a companion helper/proxy this score relies on to produce events — a watcher/poller that runs on the SOURCE host (not on the Mac running Tempo) and POSTs to /ingest. Tempo never installs or runs it; this is purely descriptive so the app can surface 'this score uses a helper'. Helper variants + README sit beside the score in its package directory and are resolved relative to the score's own location (uniform for bundled and installed scores); set 'url' when the helper is hosted elsewhere (e.g. a bare third-party score). Shape-only — a README ships beside the helper by convention but is not enforced here.

summary.description: One-line description of what the helper does.

platforms.description: Which OS variants ship in the package, by file extension. Display hint only.

url.description: External location when the helper is not bundled with Tempo. Omit or null = bundled (resolved by convention).

surface.description: Which pane this source's events render on. 'timeline' = alert feed + heatmap (participates in the needs-attention model); 'agenda' = calendar/reminders pane (read-only context, neutral pill). Defaults from eventType when omitted (alerts → timeline, everything else → agenda).

senderSeverityWins.description: When true (default), a payload's explicit non-info severity short-circuits the rules. When false, score rules always run, letting the user reclassify events from senders that over-declare severity.

severityDefault.description: Fallback severity/label/color when no rule matches.

severityRules.description: Ordered list of rules. First match wins.

match.description: Key/value pairs matched against event metadata. Values stringify before comparison; strings support shell-style globs (* and ?).

label.description: Short badge label shown in the UI.

color.description: Pill color override (#RRGGBB). Lets a rule tint its badge independently from the severity tier.

title.description: Title override (${metadata.xxx} interpolated). Replaces the event title when the rule matches.

subtitle.description: Subtitle override (${metadata.xxx} interpolated). Shown under the title in the alert card.

defaultActions.description: Actions offered for every event from this source. Per-event actions from the payload are appended.

grouping.description: Stack-grouping key template(s). Events sharing the resolved key collapse into one stack. Supports ${metadata.xxx} interpolation. Provide a single string for one template, or an array of strings for a fallback chain (runtime picks the first template that fully resolves).

groupingWindow.description: Time window inside which related events stack. Empty string = no cutoff (events stack regardless of how far apart in time).

eventPattern.description: How this source's events relate over time. 'episodic' (default) = stateful entities that flip state; 'entity' = one row per subject; 'run-bound' = a run with a start/finish lifecycle (e.g. a script). Omit for the default.

stackTitle.description: Optional ${metadata.xxx} template for the title shown on a collapsed stack's primary row.

groupingRules.description: Declarative episode/stack engine. Ordered; first match wins per event. Supersedes the legacy grouping/groupingWindow primitive when present.

indicatorRules.description: Ordered list painting a small colored indicator (or emoji) per event. First match wins. Independent from severity.

tagRules.description: Ordered list attaching a text tag to matching events. First match wins.

ackRules.description: Events matching any of these are auto-acknowledged on arrival.

dismissRules.description: Events matching any of these are auto-dismissed on arrival.

restStateOverrides.description: Rest-state classification ('server vs TV'). groupingRules declare the SERVER orientation (rest=on: the down/absent transition opens a cycle). Each override marks subjects whose rest state is OFF (a TV/decoder/phone: the cycle is on→off) — the engine swaps opens↔closes for them. Each entry also carries a per-device resolved-cycle severity (closedCycleSeverity). Default (no override) = rest on, resolved info.

color.description: Optional pill color override for the default badge.

_disabled.description: When true, the action ships with the score but is off by default — hidden until the user turns it on. Lets a score offer an optional action without cluttering the panel.

openURL.description: URL to open. Supports ${metadata.xxx} interpolation. Schemes allowed in reviewed catalog: http, https, ssh, mailto, tel, and documented app schemes.

openTerminalWith.description: Shell command to open in Terminal. NOT allowed in reviewed catalog — local drop-in only.

matchObject.description: Shallow key → expected value. Each value compares (as a string) against the event's metadata; string values may use glob wildcards * and ?.

role.description: opens/closes/continues = stateful session (a subject leaving and returning to its rest state); single = never stacks; repeats = stacks repetitions within window.

key.description: Subject-key template (e.g. ${metadata.monitorID}). Events whose key resolves equal form one episode/series.

window.description: For repeats: max stack span from the anchor. For opens: settle-gap enabling multi-cycle flap aggregation. Omit = unbounded. e.g. 5m, 2h, 6h, 1d.

stackColor.description: Stack header color basis. Omit to use the mechanism default (session → current-state, repeats → worst-severity).

color.description: Named (red/orange/yellow/green/blue/purple) or #RRGGBB. Used when emoji is omitted.

emoji.description: Rendered instead of the colored indicator when set.

restState.description: 'off' = natural-off subject (TV/decoder/phone) → swap opens↔closes. 'on' = server default (explicit; e.g. to carry only a per-device closedCycleSeverity).

closedCycleSeverity.description: Per-subject resolved-cycle severity, overriding the score-level default. Lets a server in a heterogeneous source be 'warning' while a TV is 'info'. Omit to use the score default.
